title: Signed measure difference vanishes on the whole space
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$, and let $\mu - 
u$ denote their signed measure difference. Then $(\mu - 
u)(\Omega) = 0$.
hypotheses_covered: μ is a probability measure on Ω
ν is a probability measure on Ω
replaced:
For any two probability measures $\mu$ and $\nu$, the signed difference satisfies
$(\mu - \nu)(\Omega) = 0$.
